summary: Criminal appeal against conviction for murder of six family members; prosecution burden to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt in circumstantial evidence cases; Sharad Birdhichand Sharda standard applied; chain of circumstances must be conclusive, exclude innocence hypothesis; death penalty confirmation reference; trial court conviction based on recovery, disclosure statements, blood evidence; accused's denial under Section 313 CrPC; co-accused Abhishek declared juvenile, Gayatri acquitted.
final_judgment: Death sentence confirmed; conviction upheld; co-accused Gayatri's acquittal maintained.
